string.text:
A common splint for fixing damaged bones in place. When applying the splint to your leg you will be unable to move for the duration of the application. You are able to move while it is applied to an arm.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] first-aid item
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] fast usage (tourniquet)
